proved_reduction.statement: Any finite hill arrangement and any finite set of its counted bounded triangular faces can be projectively transformed to an affine arrangement with no parallel line pairs while preserving all selected counted bounded triangular faces.

remaining_gap.issue: Conditional on the named source-scoped premises, q<=4 is excluded and q=5 profile 33334 is excluded after a five-orbit saturated-core quotient and the final K2,3 straight-line spoke contradiction. The only q=5 residual is 33333 with D2=3..7. All q>=6 cases remain open.
remaining_gap.target: Resolve q=5 profile 33333 next, preserving D2=3..7 strata and saturated-core roles; keep q>=6 separate.

claim_boundary: H1-12 is strictly narrowed, not closed. Conditional on the named source-scoped premises, any score-95 witness has either q=5 profile 33333 with 3<=D2<=7 or q>=6. No hill-global <=94, optimality, or MATHCERT claim.

source_conditional_reduction.statement: Conditional on the protected clean-line charging, endpoint-capacity, and local fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement cannot have exactly three finite multiple points. Hence any such witness must have at least four finite multiple points.
source_conditional_reduction.arithmetic_effect: The q=3 arithmetic leaves a unique saturated three-triple template; the proof note then excludes that template using the endpoint-level clean-line charge map and local fan geometry.

four_core_reduction.statement: Conditional on the stated defect/fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement with exactly four finite multiple points has multiplicities only 3333, 3334, 3335, 3344, or 3444. Adding the named clean-line/local refinements forces minimum D2 values 1, 3, 6, 5, and 6 respectively.

saturated_core_reduction.statement: Conditional on the named local no-long-run fan premise, a convex-hull vertex (extreme core) cannot be saturated. For four noncollinear cores with D2>=5, at least three cores are extreme, so at most one core may be saturated. The protected q=4 finite replay then excludes profiles 3335, 3344, and 3444, leaving only 3333 and 3334.
saturated_core_reduction.independent_component: extreme-point half-plane argument and finite replay

profile_3334_normal_form.statement: The 67 saturated-core-filtered finite states with multiplicities 3334 collapse, modulo permutation of the three triple cores, to nine graph/role types: two D2=3 stars, one non-saturated D2=4 cycle, three D2=4 star-plus-outer-edge types, and three D2=5 K4-minus-outer-pair types.
profile_3334_normal_form.independent_component: finite quotient and noncrossing of elementary D2 segments
profile_3334_normal_form.source_scoped_component: saturated hubs are non-extreme via the local no-long-run fan premise

profile_3334_d2_3_exclusion.statement: Conditional on the named local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map, neither D2=3 star role-type in profile 3334 can realize n=18,T=95.
profile_3334_d2_3_exclusion.independent_component: ordinary-endpoint transverse-line lemma and strengthened triple-hub core-line count
profile_3334_d2_3_exclusion.source_scoped_component: local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map

profile_3334_d2_4_exclusion.statement: Conditional on the named local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map, none of the four D2=4 role-types in profile 3334 can realize n=18,T=95.
profile_3334_d2_4_exclusion.independent_component: finite local cyclic enumeration, transverse-line use, and strengthened T-hub core-line count
profile_3334_d2_4_exclusion.source_scoped_component: local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map

profile_3334_d2_5_exclusion.statement: Conditional on the named local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map, none of the D2=5 K4-minus-one-edge role-types in profile 3334 can realize n=18,T=95. Therefore profile 3334 is fully excluded.
profile_3334_d2_5_exclusion.independent_component: finite cyclic deductions and charge-capacity arithmetic
profile_3334_d2_5_exclusion.source_scoped_component: local no-long-run fan premise and clean-line charging map

profile_3333_normal_form.statement: Conditional on the named triple-point local fan premise and clean-line charging map, the protected 344 labeled profile-3333 states reduce to 108 states in exactly 12 S4 normal forms; no D2=6 state survives.
profile_3333_normal_form.independent_component: finite cyclic blocked-target enumeration and S4 quotient
profile_3333_normal_form.source_scoped_component: local no-two-consecutive-D1 premise and clean-line charging map

profile_3333_saturated_hub_reduction.statement: A saturated triple hub forces ordinary separators on all three leaf-pair lines, hence D2=3 exactly and six distinct core-pair arrangement lines. Applied to the protected 3333 normal forms, this leaves 48 labeled states in eight normal forms and no D2>=5 state.
profile_3333_saturated_hub_reduction.independent_component: separator lemma, six-line core skeleton, and finite filtering
profile_3333_saturated_hub_reduction.source_scoped_component: triple-point local no-two-consecutive-D1 premise; clean-line map for lower-form exclusion

profile_3333_c4_exclusion.statement: In the sole D2=4 C4 normal form, exact charge equality forces one blocked D1 target at each core. Every admissible local equality pattern forces an arrangement line between that core's two C4 neighbors, making the core-incidence bound strict and raising the clean-line lower bound above capacity.
profile_3333_c4_exclusion.independent_component: two-type local cyclic classification and strict core-incidence refinement
profile_3333_c4_exclusion.source_scoped_component: triple-point local no-two-consecutive-D1 premise and clean-line charging map

profile_3333_nonsaturated_star_exclusion.statement: In the profile-3333 non-saturated D2=3 star equality form, an unblocked hub D1 ray forces the three D2 spokes into a consecutive block, hence an additional leaf-pair arrangement line; the core-incidence bound becomes strict and clean-line demand exceeds charge capacity.
profile_3333_nonsaturated_star_exclusion.independent_component: hub cyclic equality implication and strict core-incidence refinement
profile_3333_nonsaturated_star_exclusion.source_scoped_component: triple-point local fan/blocked-target analysis and clean-line charging map

profile_3333_saturated_equality_exclusio.statement: In the higher-count saturated D2=3 star, the alternating separator geometry puts the hub inside the leaf triangle. Exact charge equality then forces each leaf's two D1 rays to the two outward side positions, which makes the opposite hub ray a third shared ordinary segment and contradicts d1=2.
profile_3333_saturated_equality_exclusio.independent_component: interior-hub consequence, leaf ray-order classification, and forced-third-D1 contradiction
profile_3333_saturated_equality_exclusio.source_scoped_component: triple-point local fan premise and clean-line charging equality

profile_3333_triangle_isolated_normal_fo.statement: The D2=3 K3+isolated charge-equality form forces a central counted D2 triangle, an exterior isolated triple core sharing no core line with it, and exactly two edge-selection orientation types: cyclic (1,1,1) or doubled-edge (2,1,0).
profile_3333_triangle_isolated_normal_fo.independent_component: elementary-segment exclusion of the between-D2 mechanism, central-face/exterior-core consequences, and two-type quotient
profile_3333_triangle_isolated_normal_fo.source_scoped_component: triple-point local fan premise and clean-line charge equality

profile_3333_triangle_type_p_exclusion.statement: In triangle-isolated Type P, the doubled selected edge forces two distinct chargeable D1 segments to share the same unique clean transverse line M_V. Exact charge equality therefore loses one D1 charge slot and cannot serve nine clean lines.
profile_3333_triangle_type_p_exclusion.independent_component: selected-vertex M_V incidence formula and duplicate-line classification
profile_3333_triangle_type_p_exclusion.source_scoped_component: clean-line charging rule and exact equality saturation

profile_3333_triangle_type_c_exclusion.statement: In triangle-isolated Type C, every selected central vertex forces a third distinct arrangement line through a point already equal to the intersection of two arrangement lines, creating an additional finite multiple point and contradicting q=4. Together with Type P, the K3+isolated equality form is closed.
profile_3333_triangle_type_c_exclusion.source_scoped_component: predecessor local fan and clean-line equality reduction

profile_3333_p4_exclusion.statement: In the D2=3 P4 form, each degree-2 core has one or two blocked D1 targets. A one-blocked core forces an additional neighbor-pair arrangement line; a two-blocked core lowers charge capacity. The resulting (1,1), (1,2), and (2,2) cases all violate the clean-line budget.
profile_3333_p4_exclusion.source_scoped_component: triple-point local fan premise and clean-line charging map

q4_low_d2_sector_closure.statement: Requiring D1/D2 shared-ray labels to arise from actual triangular sectors sharpens triple-point blocked minima to 2 for local counts (d1,d2)=(2,1) and (2,2). This excludes the remaining D2=1 single-edge, D2=2 P3+isolated, and D2=2 2K2 forms; the protected P4 exclusion is independently strengthened as a cross-check.
q4_low_d2_sector_closure.independent_component: sector-to-shared-ray identity and finite sector enumeration
q4_low_d2_sector_closure.source_scoped_component: triple-point no-consecutive-D1 premise and clean-line charging map

q5_profile_reduction.statement: For q=5, the coarse defect/fan inequality leaves seven multiplicity profiles. Exact sector-consistent five-core graph replay plus the clean-line charge condition leaves only 33333 (D2=3..10), 33334 (D2=5..9), and 33344 (D2=6..7).
q5_profile_reduction.independent_component: coarse profile inequality, five-core graph enumeration, sector-to-shared-ray construction, and dynamic-programming replay
q5_profile_reduction.source_scoped_component: no-long-run local fan premise and clean-line charging map

q5_saturation_reduction.statement: Applying the protected saturated-core non-extremality lemma to the sector-consistent q=5 state space excludes 33344 entirely, removes 33334 states with D2>=7, and removes 33333 states with D2>=8. The retained q=5 ranges are 33333 D2=3..7 and 33334 D2=5,6.
q5_saturation_reduction.independent_component: five-core noncollinearity threshold and finite saturation counting
q5_saturation_reduction.source_scoped_component: saturated-core non-extremality plus predecessor fan/charging premises

q5_33334_closure.statement: The retained q=5 profile 33334 states quotient to five core-graph orbits under the four-triple symmetry. Saturated-triple neighbor independence excludes four; the sole K2,3 orbit would place both saturated hubs inside the same leaf triangle, forcing an elementary-spoke crossing. Hence 33334 is excluded.
q5_33334_closure.independent_component: S4 graph quotient, saturated-role extraction, neighbor-independence filter, and K2,3 straight-line crossing argument
q5_33334_closure.source_scoped_component: saturated-triple separator lemma and predecessor q=5 fan/charging state space
